scope: The three scientist execution modes (policy_design / causal_full / policy_verified): which one the production route actually selects, their real per-node failure modes on the real UA panel, and the consolidation (reuse/merge/build-out) map toward a single mode.
mode: audit-only; no runtime behavior changed; JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu; thin/synthetic-formalized input (no real fabric fetch).
audit_note: Extends GY-0 finding #1 (workflow-selection mismatch). The original census/lex/foundry audits all ran scientist_policy_design; the NL route does not select it.

bug_1_nl_never_selects_policy_design.claim: No production runtime path selects scientist_policy_design.
bug_1_nl_never_selects_policy_design.evidence: policy_mode / workflow_id are never set in nl_pipeline.py; _build_scientist_context_params (nl_pipeline.py:548) sets transport_required=True but never policy_mode; grep of src/polisyos/runtime/ (non-test) finds no scientist_policy_design / policy_mode trigger (only a string label in claim_argument.py:459).
bug_1_nl_never_selects_policy_design.impact: scientist_policy_design (37 nodes, the only mode with run_hierarchical_policy_search / lex) is reachable only via the explicit workflow_run API (launch_workflow_run reads request.params, run_lifecycle.py:1164) or reissue. The GX pinned-route artifact (layer3_gx_g4_g5_dereference_waist_court_report.json) names scientist_policy_design, but nothing in-repo triggers it.

bug_2_explicit_causal_full_overridden.claim: An explicit workflow_id=scientist_causal_full is silently overridden to scientist_policy_verified.
bug_2_explicit_causal_full_overridden.evidence: PROVEN: run_selected_workflow(workflow_id=scientist_causal_full) with a policy_question and no trinity_bundle_ref executed the policy_verified spec (28 nodes, exact match). Root: in selection.py, discovery/policy_design/policy_verified get early explicit honoring (lines 43-48), but the explicit scientist_causal_full check is at line 57 -- AFTER _should_use_policy_verified (line 53) and _execution_profile_requires_serious_workflow (line 55). So the heuristic wins over the explicit request.
bug_2_explicit_causal_full_overridden.impact: The resolver docstring ('treats explicit params.workflow_id as authoritative when it matches a supported DAG') is false for causal_full. To actually run causal_full you must ALSO provide a trinity_bundle_ref (turns off the policy_verified heuristic) or a serious execution_profile.

workflow_specs.shared_spine_node_id_identical: 19/19 common nodes carry identical node_id (real shared implementations, not name collisions)

spine_dependency_divergence.note: Same node implementations, different wiring per mode. Key divergences:
spine_dependency_divergence.run_simulation: gated by counterfactual_identification_gate ONLY in policy_design (strongest pre-sim identification discipline); causal_full/policy_verified omit that gate.
spine_dependency_divergence.run_governance: causal_full feeds transport + abm_consistency + causal_ensemble; policy_design/policy_verified feed legal_check.
spine_dependency_divergence.compile_foundry: policy_design gates on lex; causal_full on link_trinity/ready_to_run; policy_verified on formalize_verified_policy.
spine_dependency_divergence.build_decision_packet: policy_design adds build_policy_output_bundle; causal_full adds run_evaluator.

policy_design.fail_cause: lex optional-bounds bug (verified_policy_option_rate lower>=upper); see layer3_gy_lex_frontier_root_cause_audit
policy_design.note: Governance/validation tail never reached (gated by lex).

policy_verified.note: Reaches the governance/validation tail; fails there. Failure NODE is input-sensitive but deterministic for a fixed panel (3/3 identical runs failed at the same node).

causal_full.note: trinity minted by a policy_design run (formalize_verified_policy writes inputs.trinity_bundle_ref).

shared_spine_governance_tail_blocker.claim: The real production-route blocker is the SHARED governance/validation tail, not lex. It is masked in policy_design because lex fails first.
shared_spine_governance_tail_blocker.run_normative_arbitration: node.invalid_outcome -- the returned NodeOutcome fails pydantic re-validation (async_executor.py:882->903); not an execute() exception. Hits causal_full and policy_verified(60row).

build_verified_policy_report.note: All 6 phase-5 judges (structural, statistical, robustness, governance, reproducibility, compute) fail fatally on the thin/synthetic-formalized input. Deterministic 3/3.

shared_spine_governance_tail_blocker.interpretation: On thin/synthetic input the spine governance tail fails regardless of mode. lex is an additional, policy_design-only upstream blocker. Repairing lex alone does NOT unblock the route; the judge stack / phase-5 validation needs real measurement-rooted formalized input.

reuse_as_is.what: the 19-node shared spine (data plane -> foundry compile -> simulation -> analytics -> governance tail -> decision packet)
reuse_as_is.evidence: 19/19 identical node_id across all 3 modes; already shared implementations.
reuse_as_is.caveat: spine WIRING (deps) diverges per mode for 7 nodes; unification must pick a union topology with conditional edges (esp. the counterfactual_identification_gate before run_simulation, which only policy_design enforces -- keep it).

merge.legal/source arm (9 nodes): shared by policy_design + policy_verified (plan_policy_request, assemble/expand legal pack, source verification/gap review, draft/formalize, legal_check, build_verified_policy_report) -> single optional arm.
merge.literature/causal-graph arm (3 nodes): shared by policy_design + causal_full (build_literature_prior, reconcile_causal_graph, run_causal_readiness) -> single optional arm.

build_out_or_fold.decision: These two arms are the genuine capability difference between modes. A single mode must compose BOTH as conditional sub-DAGs keyed on inputs (trinity present? policy-design requested? transport required?), rather than three top-level workflows selected by a fragile heuristic.

input_contract_divergence.trinity_bundle_ref: REQUIRED by causal_full (required_binds), OPTIONAL/produced by policy_design+policy_verified (formalize_verified_policy writes it). A unified mode should treat trinity as produced-or-supplied, not a hard required_bind that silently reroutes selection.

consolidation_map.policy_verified_is_redundant: policy_verified has 0 unique nodes (strict subset of policy_design). It can be expressed as policy_design with the lex/translation arm disabled -- a strong argument it should not be a separate top-level mode.

recommended_target_for_future_work: Collapse to ONE mode = shared 19-node spine + conditional arms (legal, literature, lex/design-space, transport/ensemble) keyed on typed inputs, not on a heuristic resolver.
Make the resolver honest in the interim: honor explicit workflow_id authoritatively for ALL modes (move the causal_full explicit check above the heuristics), or delete the heuristic override.
The single mode's artifacts then support cycle/transition/rollback operations the user wants (one artifact family per stage, not three divergent ones).

Repair order is spine-first: the governance/validation judge stack (phase-5) and run_normative_arbitration outcome validation must accept real measurement-rooted input before any mode produces a publishable report; lex is a policy_design-only upstream fix on top.

production_trigger_trace.question: Who triggers scientist_policy_design in production?
production_trigger_trace.answer: No production code path selects it by default; it is reachable only by an explicit caller-supplied param.

evidence.runtime_composition: no src/polisyos/runtime/ code sets workflow_id=scientist_policy_design or the selector params.policy_mode (only a string label projection_source in claim_argument.py:459).
evidence.execution_profile: ExecutionProfile = Literal['dev','research','governed','production'] (core/contracts/control.py:38); 'policy_design' is NOT a valid profile, so _should_use_policy_design's execution_profile branch is unreachable from the API.
evidence.workflow_run_api: POST /api/v1/control/runs (control.py:115 launch_run -> run_lifecycle.py:1164 launch_workflow_run) builds state_payload.params = dict(request.params). WorkflowRunRequest (core/contracts/control.py:255) has NO first-class workflow_id field; only a freeform params dict + execution_profile.
evidence.dashboard_composer: apps/runtime-dashboard useLaunchRun -> POST /api/v1/control/runs. buildWorkflowLaunchRequest (composer/domain/forms.ts:96) sets params = operator_intent/expected_outputs/governance_constraints/atlas_context + user customParams; it never defaults workflow_id or policy_mode.
evidence.nl_path: resolves to causal_full (transport) or policy_verified (policy question); never policy_design.
evidence.harnesses_only: tools/ci/check_scientist_best_in_class_* and tools/ops_runners/experiments/run_msme_grand_tournament_v2.py set workflow_id=scientist_policy_design -- CI/ops, not production runtime.

reachable_only_via: external API client (or power-user Composer custom-param) explicitly setting params.workflow_id=scientist_policy_design or params.policy_mode=true on POST /api/v1/control/runs
reissue of a run originally launched that way
production_trigger_trace.gy_implication: The GX pinned-route artifact names policy_design as the design producer, but it is an intended-but-untriggered path. GY-0.5 must decide: (a) make policy_design the real default for policy-design intent (wire an intent->workflow_id mapping + honest resolver), or (b) scope GY-2 governance to the workflow the route actually runs (causal_full/policy_verified). Either way, GY-2 cannot assume policy_design is the production route.
